title: Enhancement: Re-enable test_pktgen.py
author: anders-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

This test was being skipped due to a bug (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/13804) The issue was resolved (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/11441), but the test was never re-enabled.

### Current Behavior

Test is skipped due to an entry in `tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/tests_mark_conditions.yaml`

### Proposed Behavior

Test will no longer be skipped.
